title: MiFID II appropriateness — refresher on private-banking advisory carve-out
content: Refresher for cross-border RMs covering EU-domiciled clients: Swiss-based advisory to EU residents continues to fall under reverse-solicitation guidance with the supplementary CPI compliance log. The appropriateness assessment must be on file, dated within the last 24 months, for any client receiving advisory recommendations on complex instruments (alternatives, structured products, leveraged funds). For execution-only requests, the appropriateness step can be waived but a written acknowledgement is required. RMs should escalate to Compliance any uncertainty about the boundary between advisory and execution-only — the regulatory tolerance for misclassification has narrowed.
